name: ramen
description: Self-hosted, multi-zone MCP server platform for GKE, EKS and AKS. A git repo of Python tools becomes canary-deployed, autoscaled Rust + Python workers with NeMo guardrails per tool, Entra ID / Google Workspace SSO, custom roles, OAuth 2.1, secrets, IP rules and audit. Clients on macOS, Windows and Linux.
